estimated_cost.description: The estimated total cost of the project, in its currency; set for over_time.

excluded_cost.description: The running total of the project's posted costs left out of its progress because they do not show it (SFRS(I) 15 B19), with its reason; absent when none.

examples: Rework of a drawing the customer had already approved

method.description: milestone: revenue is recognised as each milestone is invoiced (the default); over_time: by cost-to-cost progress, through a monthly journal proposed for approval.

version.description: The election's version, for If-Match; 0 when none was made.
